title: Terraform provider | Conditional page deletion capability
description: Introduce the ability to conditionally delete pages through the Terraform provider when managing blueprints, by specifying a deletion condition (e.g., true/false) within the Blueprint JSON file.

title: Test connection when installing a new data source
description: Enable users to validate integration setup before full installation by testing connectivity, access, and basic permissions. Reduce setup errors and improve user confidence in integration correctness during onboarding.

title: Confirmation Window for Unsaved Changes in Self-service actions GUI Mode
description:
Add a confirmation window in the GUI mode in Self-service action window to prompt users when they attempt to navigate away from the page without saving their changes. Currently, this confirmation prompt exists in JSON mode in Self-service action window, but it is missing in GUI mode, which can lead to accidental data loss.

title: Add support for AWS::RDS::DBCluster in AWS v3 integration
description:
Request to add first-class support for the AWS::RDS::DBCluster resource type to the AWS v3 integration so ElastiCache clusters can be ingested as their own kind and mapped into Port blueprints.

The feature should expose key ElastiCache cluster attributes so they can be mapped into a dedicated blueprint and used for catalog relationships and scorecards.

title: HashiCorp Vault for Secrets Management in Port Actions/Workflows
description:
When triggering webhooks or direct orchestrator calls from Port Self-Service Actions or Workflows, Port currently requires secrets (API keys, tokens) to be stored within Port itself. For organizations with strict infosec policies — where all secrets must reside exclusively in HashiCorp Vault — this is a blocker.

The workaround today is to route through a CI system (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.) that handles the Vault key exchange, but this introduces an unwanted dependency for teams using a direct orchestrator pattern where the orchestrator feeds execution feedback back into Port.

title: Enable Selection of Specific Events for Webhook Testing
description: Currently, when a webhook integration is created and events are passed to Port, there's no option to choose the event type when clicking "load latest event." We need the ability to select specific events, especially when a single webhook handles multiple event types (e.g., 2 to 3 different events).

title: Hide actions from entity menu
description:
Currently, Actions are tied to a Blueprint, and will offer all Actions for each Entity in the Catalog menu.

Having the option to hide Actions on specific Entities will allow to clean up the catalog, and disable Actions on entities that should not run it.

title: Associate action with multiple blueprints
description: Currently as it stands, an action can only be associated with one blueprint. It would be great to have an action be associated with multiple blueprints, for example if we want to restart a service, all catalogs will have service overview and likely this action will be associated with service overview entity. title: Azure Live logs
description:
Request to have a feature where Azure Entities that support live logs can be seen from inside port. 

Intent is to help ensure that when one visits the entity page, live logs of a resource appear only upon user visit action to the live logs tab under the entity

title: Add uiDefault to Prevent Validation on Initial Load
description: Add support for uiDefault option to apply default values at the UI level, preventing validation from triggering too soon during form initialization.

title: Show logs when hovering on an action in the side menu
description:
Right now when you trigger a self-service action, a menu appears on the right hand side of Port. By hovering over the running action icon, you can see some information about the action such as the title, related entity and trigger time.

It would be very convenient to also include a tail of the latest logs of the action as it is running in that hover. The hover view is rather small so it would probably be best to limit it to 10 log lines to avoid clutter.

title: Expose Catalogue Usage Telemetry
description:

title: Team inheritance support OR relationships
description:
At present it supports inheritance from a single blueprint.

Where you have multiple blueprints which a PR entity can be associated with  e.g.

- Microservice

- Tooling

- Library

Would be nice to add OR tooling OR library where a relation doesn't exist on the initial check to complete the coverage of options for inheritance

title: Disable workflow execute button while execution is in progress
description:
Currently, when a workflow is triggered, the execute button remains enabled. If the workflow takes time to start, users can click the button multiple times, unintentionally triggering duplicate executions.

The execute button should be disabled (greyed out) immediately after the first click and remain disabled until the workflow reaches a terminal state (SUCCESS, FAILURE, or DECLINED), preventing accidental multiple executions.

Users may unknowingly trigger the same workflow several times in quick succession, leading to duplicate runs and unexpected results.

title: Self-service actions - controlling the payload
description: Use JQ to manipulate the payload before sending it to the relevant workflow (Webhook, Kafka, GitHub Workflow, and any other invocation method)
